BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_onboarding_turn_command (
    student_command_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id UUID NOT NULL,
    dialog_id UUID NOT NULL,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    teacher_turn_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (teacher_turn_sequence > 0),
    canonical_student_message_id UUID NOT NULL,
    action_receipt_id UUID,
    source_event_id UUID NOT NULL,
    dialog_causation_id UUID NOT NULL,
    teacher_job_id UUID NOT NULL,
    ai_execution_id UUID,
    correlation_id UUID NOT NULL,
    causation_id UUID NOT NULL,
    request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    expected_draft_version BIGINT,
    expected_profile_version BIGINT,
    finalize_current_v1 BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    student_effect_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (student_effect_state IN ('accepted', 'no_effect')),
    result_draft_version BIGINT,
    result_profile_version BIGINT,
    no_effect_proof_id UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CONSTRAINT uq_student_onboarding_turn_canonical UNIQUE (student_id, canonical_student_message_id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_student_onboarding_turn_parent_identity UNIQUE (student_command_id, student_id, canonical_student_message_id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_student_onboarding_turn_source_event UNIQUE (source_event_id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_student_onboarding_turn_teacher_job UNIQUE (teacher_job_id),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_turn_versions CHECK (
        (student_effect_state = 'accepted'
            AND expected_draft_version IS NOT NULL AND expected_draft_version >= 0
            AND result_draft_version IS NOT NULL AND result_draft_version >= 1
            AND no_effect_proof_id IS NULL
            AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL
            AND ((finalize_current_v1
                    AND expected_profile_version IS NOT NULL AND expected_profile_version >= 0
                    AND result_profile_version IS NOT NULL AND result_profile_version >= 1)
                 OR (NOT finalize_current_v1
                    AND expected_profile_version IS NULL
                    AND result_profile_version IS NULL)))
        OR
        (student_effect_state = 'no_effect'
            AND expected_draft_version IS NULL
            AND expected_profile_version IS NULL
            AND NOT finalize_current_v1
            AND result_draft_version IS NULL
            AND result_profile_version IS NULL
            AND no_effect_proof_id IS NOT NULL
            AND accepted_at IS NULL)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_turn_causation CHECK (
        (action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL
            AND ai_execution_id IS NULL
            AND correlation_id = action_receipt_id
            AND causation_id = teacher_job_id)
        OR
        (action_receipt_id IS NULL
            AND ai_execution_id IS NOT NULL
            AND correlation_id = canonical_student_message_id
            AND causation_id = ai_execution_id)
    )
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_student_onboarding_turn_no_effect_proof
    ON student_onboarding_turn_command (no_effect_proof_id)
    WHERE no_effect_proof_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_student_onboarding_turn_action_receipt
    ON student_onboarding_turn_command (action_receipt_id)
    WHERE action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_onboarding_turn_student_created
    ON student_onboarding_turn_command (student_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_onboarding_turn_provenance (
    provenance_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_command_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES student_onboarding_turn_command(student_command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    student_id UUID NOT NULL,
    canonical_student_message_id UUID NOT NULL,
    slot_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (slot_code IN (
        'direction_code', 'self_assessed_experience', 'known_stacks', 'desired_stacks',
        'goal_code', 'goal_text', 'preferred_language', 'weekly_minutes', 'preferred_pace'
    )),
    code_value VARCHAR(64),
    text_value VARCHAR(500),
    stacks_value TEXT[],
    integer_value INTEGER,
    origin VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('explicit_ui', 'explicit_text', 'inferred', 'default')),
    confidence_basis_points SMALLINT,
    default_rule_code VARCHAR(64),
    source_message_id UUID,
    action_receipt_id UUID,
    ai_execution_id UUID,
    supersedes_provenance_id UUID,
    accepted_draft_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (accepted_draft_version >= 1),
    accepted_profile_version BIGINT CHECK (accepted_profile_version >= 1),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT uq_student_onboarding_turn_provenance_command_slot UNIQUE (student_command_id, slot_code),
    CONSTRAINT uq_student_onboarding_turn_provenance_chain UNIQUE (provenance_id, student_id, slot_code),
    CONSTRAINT fk_student_onboarding_turn_provenance_parent FOREIGN KEY (student_command_id, student_id, canonical_student_message_id)
        REFERENCES student_onboarding_turn_command(student_command_id, student_id, canonical_student_message_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CONSTRAINT fk_student_onboarding_turn_provenance_supersedes FOREIGN KEY (supersedes_provenance_id, student_id, slot_code)
        REFERENCES student_onboarding_turn_provenance(provenance_id, student_id, slot_code) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_turn_provenance_value CHECK (
        (slot_code IN ('direction_code', 'self_assessed_experience', 'goal_code', 'preferred_language', 'preferred_pace')
            AND code_value IS NOT NULL AND text_value IS NULL AND stacks_value IS NULL AND integer_value IS NULL)
        OR (slot_code = 'goal_text'
            AND code_value IS NULL AND text_value IS NOT NULL AND stacks_value IS NULL AND integer_value IS NULL)
        OR (slot_code IN ('known_stacks', 'desired_stacks')
            AND code_value IS NULL AND text_value IS NULL AND stacks_value IS NOT NULL AND integer_value IS NULL)
        OR (slot_code = 'weekly_minutes'
            AND code_value IS NULL AND text_value IS NULL AND stacks_value IS NULL AND integer_value IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_turn_provenance_origin CHECK (
        (origin = 'explicit_ui'
            AND source_message_id IS NOT NULL AND action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND ai_execution_id IS NULL
            AND confidence_basis_points IS NOT NULL AND confidence_basis_points = 10000 AND default_rule_code IS NULL)
        OR
        (origin = 'explicit_text'
            AND source_message_id IS NOT NULL AND action_receipt_id IS NULL AND ai_execution_id IS NOT NULL
            AND confidence_basis_points IS NOT NULL AND confidence_basis_points BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND default_rule_code IS NULL)
        OR
        (origin = 'inferred'
            AND source_message_id IS NOT NULL AND action_receipt_id IS NULL AND ai_execution_id IS NOT NULL
            AND confidence_basis_points IS NOT NULL AND confidence_basis_points BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND default_rule_code IS NULL)
    )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_onboarding_turn_provenance_student_slot_created
    ON student_onboarding_turn_provenance (student_id, slot_code, created_at DESC);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION student_onboarding_turn_command_immutable()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'student onboarding turn command is immutable';
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_student_onboarding_turn_command_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON student_onboarding_turn_command
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_onboarding_turn_command_immutable();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION student_onboarding_turn_provenance_immutable()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'student onboarding turn provenance is immutable';
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_student_onboarding_turn_provenance_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON student_onboarding_turn_provenance
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_onboarding_turn_provenance_immutable();

COMMIT;
